transcript.text: Do you have a masculine or feminine chin?
Here's a quick rough test for you to tell.
Imagine two sets of parallel lines coming straight down from the corners of your nose and the corners of your mouth.
If your chin is about the same width as your mouth, you probably have a masculine chin.
If it's about the same width as your nose, you probably have a feminine chin.
If you want us to analyze your face, click the link in bio at qoves.com.

narrative_arc: Pose the core question about chin shape.
Define the criteria for masculine vs. feminine chins.
Direct viewers to the website for a personalized analysis.

cta.what: Visit qoves.com to get a professional facial analysis.
